title: Spec and code stay coupled
problem: Agents implement UI and product changes without a sealed bet or open turn (violating 4f850c5a-83ce-85c9-a081-b0a3e02d2811 in spirit). Lattice then shows file lists and bare node ids instead of the plan story; Verify shows cryptic SL-00N badges without statements. Nothing flags product paths that are not covered by sealed spec, and nothing requires an align-approve JSON before push/PR/CI — skip is too easy by silence.
objective: Plan-first Lattice, and product paths need coverage approve before they ship.
acceptanceCriteria: Human-reviewed bet prose lives under docs/workstreams/ as a title-slug Markdown file; .spec-ledger holds JSON metadata only and links via specPath (repo-relative)
Sidebar wordmark is specLedger (bold 'spec', regular 'Ledger'); no 'Bets → turns → claims' subtitle under the brand

Turn detail leads with plan loaded from workstream specPath Markdown (before/after + ask), before→after diagram or flows, commit subject/body, related docs; FileDiffCard lists product files; build artifacts (.next, node_modules) excluded from impact lists
Architecture touch shows workstream link + named features (+ claim count), not only bare node ids
Verify page: covered totals (e.g. required pass/total) plus each verdict row shows claim statement primary and id secondary

Align coverage: product path is covered if it matches a graph node.locator under the turn's featureIds OR a slice expectedPaths[] entry; .spec-ledger/** and ignore globs exempt; uncovered paths reported
Code-target align approve requires treeDigest, coverageSource, uncoveredPaths (empty) or waiverIds; reviewer starts with policy.alignReviewerPrefix and must not equal turn producer
Explicit skip writes align-waiver JSON: reason (>= policy.alignWaiverMinReasonChars), actor, treeDigest, workstreamId/turnId; max alignSkipMaxPerTurn; silence is not skip; audit lists waivers
turn close refuses product-file turns without covering align-approve or waiver for that treeDigest when requireAlignApprove
scripts/git-hooks pre-push (+ documented pre-PR) and CI step 'pnpm ledger:align' fail without approve/waiver for product diffs; pnpm verify / verify workflow remain claims-pure and separate
skills/sl-dev-align/SKILL.md exists and AGENTS.md points hosts at it: cheap/Haiku-class model, ask user for coverage intent before approve
outOfScope: Hosting or running cloud LLMs inside @nessa/spec-ledger core
Making align findings affect verify.ok / ledgerDigest
Write/mutate Lattice UI (forms that change ledger)
Replacing human seal with agent seal
Semantic line-by-line 'is this justified by prose' beyond path coverage
rabbitHoles: Perfect semantic justification of every line — out; path→feature/plan coverage only in v1
residualRisks: Large uncommitted UI polish already exists under done beee03a2-1e8d-8091-9ed9-b35bea93d6a3; after seal it must land only under an open 76451749-a54f-8579-96f2-dcec19d79026 turn (8e34ebbd-c0cb-888c-95b8-0eaf07ecb634) — no further product UI until turn open
related worktree scan remains caution-only string; multi-worktree agents still need human judgment
Schema fields treeDigest/uncoveredPaths/expectedPaths are declared for this bet; CLI/runtime enforcement ships in 97bf91dc-b772-84fa-9a73-c4fe453839e9..04

schemas/align-waiver.json + write/list waiver; reason length and actor enforced
